headline: Moody's Downgrades Senegal Credit Rating for Fifth Consecutive Time
summary: Senegal's sovereign debt crisis intensified after Moody's Ratings downgraded the country for the fifth time, warning of larger potential creditor losses.
why: Sovereign credit rating downgrades raise borrowing costs for governments and impact the pricing of international bonds.

impacts.name: Senegal
impacts.why: Repeated downgrades reflect heightened default risks and increase sovereign debt servicing costs.
